project.name: Runcorn Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes:
Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 40 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 0 of 63 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

Broad visitor-attraction editorial discovery pass 2026-08-13: expanded See discovery beyond historic records using a local OSM extract. Automatically discovered additions remain below Recommended until source-backed editorial review.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Runcorn qualifies as a local detour through Halton Castle and Augustinian Abbey known as Norton Priory. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Runcorn: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Runcorn offers Halton Castle, Augustinian Abbey known as Norton Priory, Halton Castle: a ruined shell keep castle on the site of an earlier motte and bailey within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Halton Castle
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Halton Castle and Augustinian Abbey known as Norton Priory, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: Augustinian Abbey known as Norton Priory
Halton Castle: a ruined shell keep castle on the site of an earlier motte and bailey
